newsitem.title: ITALY: INA head sees no Banco Napoli problem.
newsitem.headline: INA head sees no Banco Napoli problem.

text.p: The president of Italian insurance company INA, Sergio Siglienti, denied on Monday that there was any disagreement among top management over the speed with which BNL should absorb Banco di Napoli.
Newspapers have reported that Banco Napoli Director General Federico Pepe has clashed with BNL president Mario Sarcinelli over the pace of a planned merger between the two entities.
INA and BNL have agreed jointly to acquire Banco di Napoli. After the planned BNL/Banco di Napoli merger is completed, INA is expected to end up holding some 15 percent of the merged bank.

"I am completely in agreement with the BNL president Mario Sarcinelli, nor is there any argument with the Director general of Banco di Napoli, Federico Pepe, Siglienti told reporters. --Rome newsroom +396-6782560
